label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value is bar which is derived from user input param, and although encodeForHTML is applied, the XSS vulnerability exists because the user input flows into the HTML context via the sql string that gets printed. Alert 2 (java/sql-injection): alert-TP — resolved sink sql concatenates bar which is directly from user input param, making it vulnerable to SQL injection. Both alerts are exploitable, so case TP.

evidence.note: User input retrieved via getParameter and assigned to param
Map manipulation and bar assignment from param, then used in SQL query
SQL query constructed with bar (user input) concatenated directly
User input flows into HTML output via encodeForHTML(sql) but still represents a vulnerability since sql contains user input
